subject: DPA: data jurisdiction & audit evidence before signing
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@medcorphq.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: MedCorp Legal Team <legal@medcorphq.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: DPA signing: data jurisdiction, SCCs, and audit evidence

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for sending the DPA draft earlier. Before we route this to procurement for signature, a couple quick items legal needs to confirm so we can avoid last-minute redlines:

- Do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report we can review? If you have a redacted PDF or a secure link, that would be helpful.
- We need a short pen test executive summary (high-level findings only) to satisfy our security team. Full report is fine under an NDA but we typically accept the exec summary up front.
- On data transfers: MedCorp has EU patients; we need to confirm your proposed cross-border mechanism. Are you offering SCCs or an adequacy-based transfer?
- Audit rights: clause 9.3 in your draft currently allows "reasonable audit rights". Can you confirm whether on-site audits are permitted or if you restrict to remote evidence only? Our compliance team sometimes requires limited on-site validation for high-risk vendors.

If you can send the items above and a DocuSign link (or indicate if we should redline first), we can aim to sign within the week.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Nguyen
Senior Counsel, MedCorp Health
---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@medcorphq.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA signing: data jurisdiction, SCCs, and audit evidence

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the checklist. Quick responses below and I attached the items you asked for.

- SOC 2: redacted Type II report attached (file: SOC2-TypeII-redacted.pdf). Full report available under an NDA; we can route that to MedCorp legal if required.
- Pen test: we included the executive summary (pen-test-exec-summary.pdf). It is the summary prepared by our external assessor — no exploitable findings in the last 12 months; we note remediation timelines in the doc.
- Cross-border transfers: Redwood offers SCCs for customers who require them; we can insert the SCC addendum or execute the EU SCCs clause in the DPA. For customers choosing dedicated/private deployments, we also support region pinning.
- Audit rights: our standard is to provide comprehensive remote evidence (logs, configuration snapshots, SOC 2 reports, vulnerability summaries) and to coordinate vendor assessments with a scoped third-party auditor. We generally avoid unrestricted on-site audits for hosted tenants; however, for enterprise customers we negotiate a limited on-site visit with 30 days' notice and predefined scope (no access to other customers' data or environments).

I've uploaded the supporting artifacts and started a DocuSign envelope for your team here: https://app.docusign.com/123456789/medcorp-dpa (placeholder link). Attachments included: SOC2-TypeII-redacted.pdf, pen-test-exec-summary.pdf, subprocessors-2026Q3.csv.

If MedCorp prefers to redline the DPA first, please send the redline and we will review within 48 hours.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA signing: data jurisdiction, SCCs, and audit evidence

Vanessa —

Looping in a technical note for Alice's team and ours to be aligned on audit scope:

- For on-site: we can allow a narrowly scoped, pre-approved on-site assessment limited to systems supporting the MedCorp tenancy. Physical access is available only for Redwood-managed dedicated facilities (we do not permit on-site access to cloud providers' secure areas).
- Remote evidence package we provide includes: TLS config, patching cadence, intrusion detection alerts (summary), redacted access logs, and a hash-signed configuration snapshot.
- Suggested contractual text: "Vendor will make available, upon reasonable notice and during regular business hours, remote evidence and a scoped on-site verification limited to systems that exclusively or predominantly process Customer Data, subject to Vendor's security protocols and minimum 30 days' notice."

If MedCorp insists on unlimited on-site audits, that will be a hard stop for hosted customers. We can propose a mutually agreeable remediation: allow remote-first plus a single annual on-site for enterprise customers with appropriate safeguards.

-Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

---

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@medcorphq.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: MedCorp Legal Team <legal@medcorphq.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA signing: data jurisdiction, SCCs, and audit evidence

Thanks Vanessa and Rishi — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups and next steps from our side:

- The SOC2 redacted PDF is fine for initial review. Our security team will request the full report under an NDA; can you point me to the intake for that?
- Pen test summary looks good. We may request a brief call with your assessor if any clarifying questions arise.
- SCCs: we prefer execution of the EU SCC addendum rather than a different mechanism. Please attach the SCC addendum to the DocuSign envelope (or indicate if you want us to redline).
- Audit rights: MedCorp will accept a remote-first approach with the contractual language you proposed, but we will need a one-time right to conduct a limited on-site assessment for high-risk data flows (patient-identifiable research exports). Scope and notice period to be negotiated; our preference is 30 days' notice and a maximum two-person inspection team.

If you can update the DocuSign envelope with the SCCs addendum and the NDA intake link for the full SOC2, we'll circulate to procurement. Aim to have an executed DPA by EOD next Friday if possible.

Best,
Alice
Senior Counsel, MedCorp Health

Attachments referenced: SOC2-TypeII-redacted.pdf (attached), pen-test-exec-summary.pdf (attached), subprocessors-2026Q3.csv (attached)
DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/123456789/medcorp-dpa
